fullContentHtml:
Short Information :  has recently published the official notification regarding the UPSSSC Online Time Registration (OTR) 2026 on the official website of UPSSSC. For which the details for UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration Online Form 2026 has been provided on this page. As per the notification released by the UPSSSC, it has been instructed to the aspirants who are applying for the upcoming vacancies in near future that they must have to complete their OTR Registration Process in website before applying for the UPSSSC New Vacancies. Candidates must check the complete details & process for UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration 2026 which has given below.

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC)

UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration Online Form 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 July 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : NA

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST : 0/
  • No Application Fee for Any Candidates
  • Candidates only have to register themselves.

[adinserter block=”3″]

UPSSSC OTR Registration 2026 : Age Limit

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : NA
  • Age Relaxation as per UPSSSC Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

UPSSSC OTR 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed their Junior High School Class 8 Exam in Any Recognized Board in India.
  • Any Candidates who are going to apply for any of the UPSSSC New Recruitment 2026-27 can register themselves in UPSSSC Website which helps to candidates to save their time.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

UPSSSC OTR Registration 2026 : Benefits

  • Applicant Needs to Fill Personal Details Only Once.
  • Applicant Needs to Upload Documents Only Once.
  • OTR Information is Digitally Available Anytime Anywhere.
  • Information Get Automatically Populated While Applying Under Any Commission’s Notification

UPSSSC OTR Registration 2026 : Requisites Document of Online Application

  • Proof of identity (Aadhaar/Digilocker/PAN/Passport/Driving License)
  • Valid mobile number and email (for OTP verification)
  • Passport-size photograph (JPG) and scanned signature
  • Educational certificates (10th/12th mark sheets, etc.)
  • Category or disability certificate, if applicable

UPSSSC OTR Registration 2026 : Popular Vacancy

  • UP Police Constable
  • UP Police Sub Inspector SI
  • UP Police Assistant Sub Inspector ASI
  • UP Police Computer Operator / Programmer
  • All Other Vacancy UP Police Recruitment

UPSSSC OTR Registration Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • In order to register for the UPSSSC OTR, candidates need to go to the important link section provided below.
  • After getting the link named as ‘Register Here / New OTR Registration’ candidates need to click it for doing the registration. 
  • After that, Candidates will be redirected to UPSSSC OTR Registration Page, Here they have to click on New Registration Tab.
  • Now,  they have to provide their basic details -:
  • Mobile Number
  • Email Id
  • DOB
  • Name
  • Father’s Name
  • Mother’s Name
  • Class 10th Roll Number etc.
  • After that carefully check your OTR Profile Details & then click on Submit Registration.
  • Now, An OTP will be received on the registered email and registered mobile number of the candidate which they have to provide for getting their registration completed.
  • Once the registration process gets completed, candidate will get the OTR ID, kindly take print of that page & save it for your future purpose.
  • Now, the candidates have to login once again to change their UPSSSC OTR ID Password.
  • After following all the above listed procedure, UPSSSC OTR registration process will get completed, & candidates may apply for any UPSSSC Recruitment / Exams conducted by the commission in future.

Important Question

Q. What is UPSSSC OTR 2026?
Answer. UPSSSC OTR (One Time Registration) is a one-time registration process required for candidates who want to apply for UPSSSC recruitment exams.

Q. What is the application start date for UPSSSC OTR 2026?
Answer. The online application process starts on 14 July 2026.

Q. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC OTR 2026?
Answer. No last date has been announced yet (NA).

Q. Is there any application fee for UPSSSC OTR?
Answer. Candidates should check the official notification for details regarding the registration fee, if applicable.

Q. Who can apply for UPSSSC OTR 2026?
Answer. Any candidate who wishes to apply for future UPSSSC recruitment examinations can complete the One Time Registration.

Q. What documents are required for UPSSSC OTR?
Answer. Candidates generally need a passport-size photograph, signature, Aadhaar/mobile number, email ID, and educational details while completing the registration.

Q. Can I edit my OTR details after registration?
Answer. Yes, candidates can edit eligible details through the OTR portal as per UPSSSC guidelines.

Q. Why is UPSSSC OTR mandatory?
Answer. OTR is mandatory because candidates must complete One Time Registration before applying for any UPSSSC recruitment notification.

Q. What is UPSSSC Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of UPSSSC is https://upsssc.gov.in/
